notes: SOURCE: anonymity-protected digital edition, 159 PDF pages (printed page = PDF page + 1 in the roster section). Rosters: Conference Committees PDF p.148; 2025 Chairpersons/Alternates, Trustees' Committees and GSB officers p.149; Conference Members (trustees, nontrustee directors, newly elected) pp.150-153; Area Delegates pp.154-155; AAWS/Grapevine directors, GSO & Grapevine staff, nonvoting resources p.156; Delegates Bid Farewell p.157. Page images of pp.148-149 and 154-155 were checked to confirm the column order; no footer interleaving problems on p.148. DELEGATES: all 93 areas represented by their delegate (no alternates/vacancies noted). Panel 73 = 48 areas, Panel 74 = 45. Delegate names use the Area Delegates list spelling everywhere (committees, next-year chairs). Variants printed in the committee roster / 2025 chairs table: A9 'Alexandra W.' / 'Alex W.' (list: 'Alex (Alexandra) W.'); A12 'Ilir T.' (list prints 'Ilir M T.' without a period - kept as printed); A20 chairs table 'Eric L.' (list 'Erik L.'); A21 'Tom H.'; A22 'Mike M.'; A32 and A78 are printed in committee lists with an extra middle/maiden surname (omitted for anonymity); A49 committee roster prints 'Jo Ann M.' but the delegate list prints 'Jo Ann D.' (list spelling used); A50 'Steve J.'; A53 'Ed A.'; A54 'Tim H.'; A59 the committee roster prints a full surname ('Pete B...') - reduced, list spelling 'Peter B.' used; A65 'Rick W.'; A66 committee roster 'Linda W.' vs list 'Melinda W.'; A69 'Dave R.'; A70 'Jim T.' vs list 'James T.'; A88 committee roster 'Cecil L.' vs list/farewells 'Céline L.'; A90 'Deb L.' vs list 'Debbie L.'. CONFERENCE COMMITTEES: 11 primary committees (8-9 members each, 93 delegates total) + 2 secondary (Archives, ICRF, marked 1). The Grapevine and La Viña committee lists two secretaries (Paola M., La Viña Editor, and Jon W., Grapevine Editor in Chief); ICRF lists two (Eileen A., Patrick C.) - 'secretary' holds the first printed, extra key 'secretaries' holds both. Finance secretary Zenaida M. (Controller, nonalcoholic employee) and Archives secretary Michelle M. (Archivist) are printed with full surnames - reduced to initials. No trustees/directors are listed inside Conference committee rosters. TRUSTEES' COMMITTEES: heading carries a '*' footnote 'Members of this committee serve on this as a secondary committee assignment' but no individual committee is marked, so secondary=false for all (the other '*' footnote says the GSB chair/interim chair and the GSO general manager are ex officio members). Robert L. is International 'vice chair' (type member, extra key title). Corrections secretary Eileen A. is 'interim secretary'. ICRF has two secretaries (Patrick C. - International Conventions; Eileen A. - Regional Forums). The trustees' Literature secretary is printed as Rainer L., although Sandra W.'s staff report says the Literature coordinator serves the trustees' and Conference Literature committees. NAMES: Class A trustees and nonalcoholic employees printed with full names reduced to first name + last initial and with titles/suffixes dropped: 'Sr. Judith Ann ...' -> Judith Ann K.; 'Hon. Kerry ...' -> Kerry M.; 'Al J. ..., III, MD' -> Al M.; 'Anadora (Andie) ...' -> Andie M.; 'Molly A. ...' -> Molly O.; 'Kevin J. ..., MBA, CFA, CPA' -> Kevin P.; 'Dawn M. ...' -> Dawn K.; CFO 'Paul K...' -> Paul K. One canonical form per person is used across all lists (trustees-committee lists print the short forms). 'Teddy B-W.' (as printed) normalized to 'Teddy B.-W.'; 'Irma V.' in some lists = 'Irma V. B.-N.'. The GM is printed 'Robert (Bob) W.' / 'Bob W.' / 'Robert W.' - recorded as 'Bob W.'. TRUSTEES: 20 (6 Class A, 14 Class B). Rotating (*): Mike L. (West Central) and Irma V. B.-N. (Western Canada); nontrustee director Cindy F. (Grapevine) also rotating. trustee_committees = union of the bio text and the 2024 Trustees' Committees roster (roster adds: Judith Ann K. Compensation chair; Reilly K. Public Information; Vera F. Literature; Robert L. International vice chair). David S. bio gives no trustee election date (says he 'served as Grapevine director from April 2022-2023'; probably elected general service trustee April 2023) -> elected_year null; his position (general service trustee) is from the AA Grapevine directors list. past_delegate areas not printed in the bios are left null; likely areas from city/bio: Cathi C. Panel 64 ~Area 23 (she was 'Area 23 archivist'), Tom H. Panel 62 ~Area 16, Teresa J. Panel 68 ~Area 46, Marita R. Panel 49 unknown (lived in other areas), Joyce S. Panel 65 ~Area 83, Irma V. B.-N. Panel 59 ~Area 91, Cindy F. Panel 61 ~Area 71, Nikki O. Panel 70 ~Area 28. Printed as-is although possibly misprints: Mike L. (Omaha, NE) 'Panel 53 delegate from Area 24' (Area 24 = Iowa); Vera F. (Lanesborough, MA) 'Panel 68 delegate for Area 58' (Area 58 = Oregon). Mike L. was interim GSB chair (office of chair vacant) and ex officio on all trustees' committees. NEWLY ELECTED: Charles H. (bio also calls him 'Charlie'), Gail P., Dawn K. (Class A) and Nikki O. (Grapevine nontrustee director; class null) from the 'elected by the General Service Board following the 2024 Conference' sections; Scott H., past Class B trustee, added from the trustees' Nominating report / Trustees Committee slate: elected GSB chair following the 2024 Conference (position_id OTHER, city not printed). GSO STAFF: the 11 voting GSO staff listed under 'General Service Office Staff' plus Rainer L. and Nick S. (listed as 'GSO Staff' among nonvoting resources; new staff hires since the 73rd GSC). Assignments assembled from the Staff Services department report, the signed Staff Reports in 'Trustees' Committees and Staff Reports', and the committee rosters. Staff director = Sandra W. (Director of Staff Services, also Literature desk). Conference membership check: 93 delegates + 20 trustees + 6 nontrustee directors + 11 GSO staff + 2 Grapevine staff + GM + Grapevine publisher (Chris C.) = 134, matching the report's '134 Conference members'. CONFERENCE CHAIR: Mary A., Area 14 North Florida (Panel 73), Conference Delegate Chair; Karen C. (Area 78) announced as incoming delegate chair-elect. FAREWELLS: 'the 48 rotating delegates' (Panel 73) - farewell_count 48. AUDIT (2024): verified against page images pp.148-149, 154-156 and text pp.150-157. Every Conference-committee line (area, panel, */** mark, secretary), all 93 Area Delegates entries (area, name, panel, city), the 2025 chairs table, the trustees' committees, GSB officers, the AAWS/Grapevine directors and the GSO/Grapevine staff lists match the source. 'Orientation' and 'Policy' in trustee_committees were normalized to 'Orientation (ad hoc)' / 'Policy (ad hoc)' (the same ad hoc committees as in the other bios). Source inconsistencies kept as printed: Kerry M.'s bio says she serves on the Audit Committee, but the 2024 Audit roster does not list her (kept from the bio); the Nominating report calls Mike L. 'interim chair ... and 1st Vice-Chairperson of the GSB', while the officers list names Judith Ann K. as First Vice-Chair (officers list followed). David S.: the 2023 Final Report lists him among the Class B trustees elected by the GSB following the 2023 Conference (general service trustee, so April 2023); this 2024 report does not state it, so elected_year stays null.
